evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/f/d owns the live CopyOnWriteArrayList<ColorTileMarker>, config persistence under group 'groundMarker', mark/unmark menu injection, color reset/pick actions and conversion between R482 GroundMarkerPoint and ColorTileMarker.
The plugin serializes region_<id> collections of GroundMarkerPoint through Gson/config storage, reloads them with its nested TypeToken helper, and reconstructs WorldPoint-backed live markers.
Surviving exact-v308 menu text includes 'Mark', '<img=25> Unmark', 'Reset color', 'Pick color' and generated color choices, matching the RuneLite Ground Marker plugin interaction flow.
Historical RuneLite GroundMarkerPlugin has the same groundMarker config group, tile-marking menu lifecycle, persisted region markers and ColorTileMarker/GroundMarkerPoint conversion structure.
R188 fixes rs/s/f/c as CLIENT_CLASS_000909 and R482 fixes rs/s/f/f as 000912; contiguous exact-v308 class order fixes rs/s/f/d as CLIENT_CLASS_000910.

proposals.note: Source-correlated exact-v308 recovery of the live RuneLite GroundMarkerPlugin controller.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/f/b is a config interface whose surviving constants are exactly 'groundMarker' and 'showImportExport'; its default methods expose marker color, import/export toggle, label toggle, border width and fill opacity values consumed by R188 GroundMarkerOverlay.
R188 GroundMarkerOverlay injects rs/s/f/b and reads its marker color/border/fill/label settings while rs/s/f/d injects the same interface as the Ground Marker plugin controller.

Historical RuneLite GroundMarkerConfig preserves the same config group 'groundMarker', key 'showImportExport', default marker color and overlay presentation settings, fixing the original source identity.
R482 fixes rs/s/f/a at CLIENT_CLASS_000907 and R188 fixes rs/s/f/c at 000909; contiguous exact-v308 class order therefore fixes rs/s/f/b as CLIENT_CLASS_000908.
